accepted_basis_confirmation_note: Durable confirmations identify the actual controlling head or edition when that distinction matters to later reconstruction.
authoritative_help_or_restart_note: When the basis drift is too material for safe silent continuation, the route keeps one authoritative restart or help lane visible.
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that may preserve or resume progress across changing public guidance keep the previously reviewed basis, the current controlling basis, and any required re-review or restart visibly distinct enough that continuity is not mistaken for unchanged authority.
expected_head_surface_label: Example State official voter-information expected-head / mid-flow version-drift policy
historical_basis_reference_note: Earlier reviewed heads may remain referenceable for records or dispute review without being implied to remain safely actionable.
material_basis_change_note: Material changes that alter the next action, acceptance conditions, deadline semantics, office destination, or required instructions are treated differently from cosmetic edits.
queued_send_expected_head_note: If a request may queue before later send, the route keeps expected-head truthfulness separate from queue status so preserved state does not imply unchanged governing instructions.
re_review_or_restart_policy_note: When a material basis change occurs before completion, the route requires visible re-review, bounded restart of the affected portion, or authoritative help instead of silently continuing under the earlier reviewed basis.
resumed_state_expected_head_note: A resumed draft or restored step makes clear whether the previously reviewed basis still controls or whether a newer expected head now requires re-review.
